summary: The art/anim era ran the SAME ratio failure the ARCH kickoff treats as new. Between SESSION18 A4.4 (24c56ef) and SESSION23 A11.1 (3bd5814) — four sessions, 29 commits, 25 hours — src/game/DuelScene.ts was never touched; the only src/game/ files that moved were IdleFighterScene.ts (the ?art= debug route) and art/fighterShapes.ts. The kickoff written at SESSION20's close was titled 'PUT THE OG FIGHTER IN THE GAME' and pinned gate A7-F specifically 'so a wiring session cannot quietly become an art session'; it was rewritten into an art session 7 minutes later (757438c 00:19 -> a415411 00:26) and the wiring slipped twice more. Second structural finding: the gate apparatus grew 742 -> 894 tests plus inkShare, colourRuler, scorePose, held-out frames and a tuning loop, and in this window 9 separate commits attribute their originating finding to the owner LOOKING at the render — every one of them on a fully green suite. The gates confirmed defects after the owner named them (37801fe: 'he named the COUNT exactly - it is two'); they did not originate them. Third: the gate that everything hung on was graded against a contaminated target for ten days — reference/combat_idle_measurements.md called rows 616-638 'Kasa (hat)' when those rows are the health bar and the SOUND360 watermark, and SESSION18's kickoff labelled that table '✅ WHAT WE *CAN* GRADE AGAINST, AND IT IS REAL' and 'the strongest scale evidence in the repo'. That contamination drove an owner ruling (44ef334). Two standing rules are inverted or unenforced in practice: -SESSION-LOG.md ('updated per milestone, never at the end') received 723 lines covering SESSIONS 18-22 in one wrap commit and was untouched across all of SESSIONS 16/17/19/20/21, while RESUME_HERE.md ('refreshed in the SAME commit') is checked by nothing, sails through a docs-only fast-path in the pre-commit hook, and silently carried the wrong kickoff in 4601761 while that commit's subject asserted 'SESSION 24 kickoff committed and graded'. Kickoff self-grades have zero predictive value: 5 of 9 kickoffs in this slice were repaired or rewritten within 34 minutes of being graded 'bar: met'.
